text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo... hah, hah...
(Ring-ring!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo... hah, hah...
(Ring-ring!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I guess the training camp is almost over, 
huh... The morning runs we did every 
day... But...)
(Ring-ring!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(The sound of that bicycle bell used to 
feel like so much pressure... but now, I 
don't really mind it.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...

"Right in the middle of my run, I suddenly 
stopped to look out at the morning sea, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...So pretty~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Back in the beginning, I had no time to 
look at the ocean while running at all...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still, for now...

Of course, she's out of breath. But she's 
not completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Strong? Do you really think so?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, as much as the effort you put in.
Yeah, as much as the effort you put in.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hard work... That is, well...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I did! Best one so far!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I had such an awful time, geez~ I'll never 
forget this summer as long as I live~

She is smiling through her tears. Along 
with deep, heartfelt emotion...

The memory of 'working hard enough to 
match any other Umamusume' was etched 
deeply into the easygoing Hishi Miracle's 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the only disappointing thing was... 
the summer festival, you see.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"So in the end, we couldn't go, huh? Ahhh, 
next year for sure...!"
choice_data_list:
In that case, we're all good! It's today, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh... Today...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, does that mean I can go? Is it 
really okay for me to go...?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, as a reward for all your hard work!
Yeah, as a reward for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yay, we did itttt~...!!

That had been my intention from the start. 
To mark the end of a hard-fought summer—
(*whistle*, *KABOOM!!*)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, Trainer... Trainer... I...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm having fun, I'm really living it up~. 
So fun, it's crazy! ...But, somehow I 
can't quite relax.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? It's really okay? For me to 
enjoy the summer festival?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, it's a reward for all your hard 
work!
Yeah, it's a reward for working so hard!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haua~, so this is what true effort looks 
like~. It really sinks in~, it hits right 
home~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I really gave it my all, didn't I? I was 
actually able to do my best, really...

Hishi Miracle felt it deeply. Pushing her 
to the limit was tough and heartbreaking, 
but...

At long last, I managed to instill an 
awareness of hard work into the oblivious 
Hishi Miracle.
